analyst_view.overall: Angers are 17th with 8 points from 11 games under Stephane Gilli and have taken one point from their last five league games (2 scored, 13 conceded). Lens are 11th with 14 points and lost 3-1 at RB Leipzig on Tuesday, their fourth Champions League defeat in a row; captain Florian Thauvin, their top scorer and assist maker (7 goals, 9 assists), cut short a TV interview afterwards but apologised on Wednesday, said he is staying until the end of the season, and the club will not sanction him, so he is expected to start. Didier Digard, Lens' third coach this season, drew 1-1 with Toulouse in his first league game, and Lens have four days' rest after Leipzig. The numbers already take off Edouard, Aguilar, Cuisance and Nawrocki for Lens and Diatta for Angers; Angers trained with almost the whole squad on Tuesday, with only keeper Melvin Zinga and Jules Bouffandeau absent for unstated reasons. Referee Romain Lissorgue (4.2 cards a game) is already counted, so nothing here moves the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, Lens 1.5 and Angers 0.9; they already take off Edouard, Aguilar and Cuisance (about -12% for Lens) and know Angers have scored 3 in their last 6. Thauvin has apologised and should play, and Zinga's absence from one training session is not explained, so I stay at about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.0 corners, 5.3 for Lens and 4.7 for Angers. Lens had 9 corners and most of the ball against Toulouse and Angers sit deep when behind, but that pattern is already in the recent counts the numbers use, so I stay at about 10.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards: referee Romain Lissorgue (4.2 a game) adds about 8%, while both sides' calm recent card counts take some off. Angers' relegation worry and Lens' frustration could add edge, but there is no history of needle in this fixture, so I stay at about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.0 shots, 15.4 for Lens and 10.6 for Angers, already counting how much Angers have conceded lately. Lens used their regulars at Leipzig (Thauvin, Sotoca, Sima) and have four days to recover, with no rotation announced, so I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target, 5.7 for Lens and 4.0 for Angers, already without Edouard and raised a little for both defences' recent leaks. Lens' front three should be the same as at Leipzig and Angers' weak attack is already counted, so I stay at about 9.7.
